item.title: Trump administration blacklists Megaspeed, key firm in Nvidia scandal
item.dc:creator: Miriam Waldvogel
item.description: The Trump administration on Monday added Megaspeed, the Southeast Asian company at the center of the Nvidia scandal, to its trade blacklist.

item.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang after Trump speaks ‘directly’ to board
item.dc:creator: Gerrit De Vynck, Shira Ovide, Faiz Siddiqui
item.description: The turnaround comes after the board “received input from senior levels of the United States government,” the company said in a statement Monday.

item.title: Jensen Huang went to war with Washington — and won a path to China
item.dc:creator: Ian Duncan
item.description: The Nvidia founder wooed the president and pushed back against lawmakers as the company sought a foothold in the vast Chinese market. The tactics left a trail of mistrust.

item.title: Trump urges Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang, calling him ‘best thing’ for U.S.
item.dc:creator: Taz Ali
item.description: President Donald Trump has repeatedly defended the former chief executive of the computer chip giant.

item.title: This setting may make your laptop smoother to use
item.dc:creator: Rob Pegoraro
item.description: Try these tips to reduce the times you unintentionally right-click or open a window.
